text: In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods table, in the TEST GROUP A - ACCELERATED ENVIRONMENT STRESS TESTS group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:Preconditioning test item is: "Performed on surface mount devices only. PC performed before THB/HAST, AC/UCHST, TC, and PTC stresses. It is recommended that J-STD-020 be performed to determine what preconditioning level to perform in the actual PC stress per JA113. The minimum acceptable level for qualification is level 3 per JA113. Where applicable, preconditioning level and Peak Reflow Temperature must be reported when preconditioning and/or MSL is performed. Delamination from the die surface in JA113/J-STD-020 is acceptable if the device passes the subsequent Qualification tests. Any replacement of devices must be reported. TEST before and after PC at room temperature."

In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods table, in the TEST GROUP A - ACCELERATED ENVIRONMENT STRESS TESTS group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:Temperature-Humidity-Bias or Biased HAST test item is: "For surface mount devices, PC before THB (85°C/85%RH for 1000 hours) or HAST (130°C/85%RH for 96 hours, or 110°C/85%RH for 264 hours). TEST before and after THB or HAST at room and hot temperature."

In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods table, in the TEST GROUP A - ACCELERATED ENVIRONMENT STRESS TESTS group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:Autoclave or Unbiased HAST or Temperature-Humidity (without Bias) test item is: "For surface mount devices, PC before AC (121°C/15psig for 96 hours) or unbiased HAST (130°C/85%RH for 96 hours, or 110°C/85%RH for 264 hours). For packages sensitive to high temperatures and pressure (e.g., BGA), PC followed by TH (85°C/85%RH) for 1000 hours may be substituted. TEST before and after AC, UHST, or TH at room temperature."

In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods (continued) table, in the TEST GROUP A - ACCELERATED ENVIRONMENT STRESS TESTS (CONTINUED) group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:Temperature Cycling test item is: "PC before TC for surface mount devices. Grade 0: -55°C to +150°C for 2000 cycles or equivalent. Grade 1: -55°C to +150°C for 1000 cycles or equivalent. Note: -65°C to 150°C for 500 cycles is also an allowed test condition due to legacy use with no known lifetime issues. Grade 2: -55°C to +125°C for 1000 cycles or equivalent. Grade 3: -55°C to +125°C for 500 cycles or equivalent. TEST before and after TC at hot temperature. After completion of TC, decap five devices from one lot and perform WBP (test #C2) on corner bonds (2 bonds per corner) and one mid-bond per side on each device. Preferred decap procedure to minimize damage and chance of false data is shown in Appendix 3."

In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods (continued) table, in the TEST GROUP A - ACCELERATED ENVIRONMENT STRESS TESTS (CONTINUED) group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:Power Temperature Cycling test item is: "PC before PTC for surface mount devices. Test required only on devices with maximum rated power ≥ 1 watt or ΔTJ ≥ 40°C or devices designed to drive inductive loads. Grade 0: Ta of -40°C to +150°C for 1000 cycles. Grade 1: Ta of -40°C to +125°C for 1000 cycles. Grades 2 and 3: Ta -40°C to +105°C for 1000 cycles. Thermal shut-down shall not occur during this test. TEST before and after PTC at room and hot temperature."

TEST before and after HTSL at room and hot temperature. * NOTE: Data from Test B3 (EDR) can be substituted for Test A6 (HTSL) if package and grade level requirements are met."

In the AEC_Q100_Rev_H_Base_Document file, in the Table 2: Qualification Test Methods (continued) table, in the TEST GROUP B - ACCELERATED LIFETIME SIMULATION TESTS group, the content of the ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS field of the STRESS:High Temperature Operating Life test item is: "For devices containing NVM, endurance preconditioning must be performed before HTOL per Q100-005. Grade 0: +150°C Ta for 1000 hours. Grade 1: +125°C Ta for 1000 hours. Grade 2: +105°C Ta for 1000 hours. Grade 3: +85°C Ta for 1000 hours. HTOL NOTES: 1) HTOL stress times for the appropriate grade Ta are the min requirement; the Ti of the test (measured or calculated) should be available. 2) Ti may be used instead of Ta when performing HTOL provided that Ti of the device under HTOL conditions is equal to or higher than the Ti maximum operating (Tjopmax) of the particular device, but below the absolute maximum Ti. 3) If Ti is used to set the HTOL conditions, the minimum stress of 1000 hours at the Ta of the device is to be shown using activation energy of 0.7ev or other value technically justified. 4) Vcc(max) at which dc and ac paramedics are guaranteed. Thermal shut-down shall not occur during this test. TEST before and after HTOL at room, cold, and hot temperature (in that order)."
